author: cens0r3d
install_msg: fakemessage loaded. `/fakemessage`, `/fakewhatsapp`, `/faketelegram`, `/faketweet`, `/faketwitch`, `/fakekick` (prefix: `[p]fakewa`, `[p]faketg`, `[p]faketweet`, `[p]faketwitch`, `[p]fakekick`). Run `[p]slash enablecog fakemessage` and then `[p]slash sync` to publish the slash commands. The bot needs Attach Files, the host needs Pillow (`[p]pipinstall pillow`).
name: fakemessage
description: Renders one message as a screenshot of Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram, X, Twitch chat or Kick chat: real avatar and role colour, the platform's own bubble, its own markdown and Twemoji. Pillow draws at 2x and downsamples once.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any user data. Avatars and emoji are fetched while a command runs and cached as pictures; nothing is tied to a user id.
